sources.title: Rekor transparency service specification
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Fulcio：憑證SAN與OIDC發行者的雙重身分綁定
related.titleEn: Fulcio: binding certificate SAN to OIDC issuer identity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：66.667%與83.333%可重算，剩餘缺口未被隱藏；包含、簽章與一致性結果分欄。 交付rekor-checkpoints.csv、六段證明清單與矛盾根反例；本課不向公開日誌上傳任何資料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce approximately 66.667 and 83.333 percent without hiding the remaining gap, and report inclusion, checkpoint signature and consistency separately. Deliver rekor-checkpoints.csv, the six-transition proof inventory and conflicting-root counterexamples. The exercise uploads nothing to a public transparency log.
related.difference: 建立14份公開憑證描述，保留SAN、OIDC issuer擴充、EKU與簽章時間；另列CA發行者名稱，明確區別X.509 issuer與OIDC issuer。
related.differenceEn: Build 14 public certificate descriptors with SAN, OIDC issuer extension, EKU and signing time. Record the CA issuer name separately, explicitly distinguishing an X.509 issuer from the identity-provider issuer used by the signer policy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課計算已驗證連續轉移佔所有預期轉移的比例；這是證據覆蓋指標，不是透明日誌誠實機率。簽章正確並不單獨證明兩個根前綴一致。 有7個依序檢查點形成6段轉移，其中4段具有效一致性證明，2段缺證明；所有簽章與log識別已先通過。 覆蓋率4/(7−1)×100≈66.667%；補齊一段有效證明後為5/6×100≈83.333%，仍有一段未確認。
本地政策要求SAN與OIDC發行者精確匹配，且先通過鏈與用途檢查；不能把issuer的字串部分比對或顯示名稱當作穩定身分。 14份中10份SAN符合，其中8份也符合OIDC issuer；另外4份SAN不同，皆不納入雙重匹配集合。 雙重匹配率8/14×100≈57.143%；修復一份測試描述的issuer關聯後為9/14×100≈64.286%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Measure verified consecutive transitions among expected transitions as evidence coverage, not the probability that a log is honest. Valid checkpoint signatures alone do not establish that one committed tree is an append-only prefix of another. Seven ordered checkpoints create six transitions. Four have valid consistency proofs and two lack them; signatures and log identities have already passed independent checks, isolating continuity evidence from checkpoint authentication. Coverage is 4/(7−1)×100, approximately 66.667 percent. Adding one valid proof yields 5/6×100, approximately 83.333 percent, leaving a transition unresolved rather than proving complete continuity.

The local policy requires exact SAN and OIDC issuer matches after chain and usage checks. Substring issuer matching and display-name comparison are not stable identity contracts and must not substitute for the selected typed certificate fields. Ten of 14 descriptors match SAN, and eight of those also match OIDC issuer. Four have a different SAN and remain outside the joint set even if they share an otherwise trusted CA or identity provider. Joint matching is 8/14×100, approximately 57.143 percent. Correcting one fixture issuer association gives 9/14×100, approximately 64.286 percent, without adding another trusted identity provider.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: pip：完整相依雜湊鎖定與平台wheel選取
related.titleEn: pip: complete dependency hashes and platform-wheel selection
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：66.667%與83.333%可重算，剩餘缺口未被隱藏；包含、簽章與一致性結果分欄。 交付rekor-checkpoints.csv、六段證明清單與矛盾根反例；本課不向公開日誌上傳任何資料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce approximately 66.667 and 83.333 percent without hiding the remaining gap, and report inclusion, checkpoint signature and consistency separately. Deliver rekor-checkpoints.csv, the six-transition proof inventory and conflicting-root counterexamples. The exercise uploads nothing to a public transparency log.
related.difference: 建立12個本地套件需求描述，列精確版本、平台標籤、核准wheel摘要及遞移邊；使用假檔案做雜湊核對，不安裝未知套件。
related.differenceEn: Build 12 local requirement descriptors with exact versions, platform tags, approved wheel digests and dependency edges. Use inert files for hash checks and never install unknown packages merely to demonstrate dependency resolution.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課計算已驗證連續轉移佔所有預期轉移的比例；這是證據覆蓋指標，不是透明日誌誠實機率。簽章正確並不單獨證明兩個根前綴一致。 有7個依序檢查點形成6段轉移，其中4段具有效一致性證明，2段缺證明；所有簽章與log識別已先通過。 覆蓋率4/(7−1)×100≈66.667%；補齊一段有效證明後為5/6×100≈83.333%，仍有一段未確認。
本課完整度要求每個實際選中產物都有預先核准雜湊；平台不同可能需多個合法wheel摘要，不能直接把下載當下算出的雜湊視為獨立批准。 12個選中需求中9個有精確版本與核准摘要，3個遞移需求缺雜湊；缺漏者分開列出，不能以no-deps隱藏。 完整度9/12×100=75%；補齊兩個遞移需求的已審查摘要後為11/12×100≈91.667%，仍不足整體安裝驗收。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Measure verified consecutive transitions among expected transitions as evidence coverage, not the probability that a log is honest. Valid checkpoint signatures alone do not establish that one committed tree is an append-only prefix of another. Seven ordered checkpoints create six transitions. Four have valid consistency proofs and two lack them; signatures and log identities have already passed independent checks, isolating continuity evidence from checkpoint authentication. Coverage is 4/(7−1)×100, approximately 66.667 percent. Adding one valid proof yields 5/6×100, approximately 83.333 percent, leaving a transition unresolved rather than proving complete continuity.

Completeness requires a previously approved hash for every selected artifact. Different platforms may need multiple legitimate wheel hashes, but computing a hash immediately after an unreviewed download does not independently authorize its contents. Nine of 12 selected requirements have exact versions and approved hashes, while three transitive requirements lack hashes. List them explicitly instead of hiding the incomplete graph with a no-deps option or an already populated environment. Completeness is 9/12×100=75 percent. Adding reviewed hashes for two transitive requirements gives 11/12×100, approximately 91.667 percent, still insufficient for accepting the entire installation set.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
